subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Emulate
solution:
The correct answer is **Neglect**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate antonym for the given word '**Emulate**' is '**Neglect**'.
 
• The meaning of the word **Emulate **is '**to try to do something as well as, or better than, somebody**'.
 
• The meaning of the word '**Neglect**' is '**to give too little or no attention or care to somebody/something**'.
 
• Hence, the most appropriate answer is '**Neglect**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's understand the other options.
 
 
• **Respect**- the feeling that you have when you admire or have a high opinion of somebody/something.
 
• **Spoilt**- to change something good into something bad, unpleasant, useless, etc.; to ruin something.
 
• **Bash**- to hit somebody/something very hard.
